Subject: Gravelin Distribution - Outside Appetite

Hi Tomas,

Thank you for the submission on Gravelin Distribution. Unfortunately, we'll need to decline this opportunity.

Our concern is that the operations involve fireworks/explosives (Class FIRE), which falls outside our appetite. We also noticed a discrepancy—the application declares warehouse operations (WHSE), but the actual operations describe fireworks/explosives handling.

Given the specialized nature of this risk, I'd recommend reaching out to a surplus lines carrier or specialty market that focuses on hazardous materials and explosives. They'll be better equipped to provide appropriate coverage.

Please let me know if you have any questions, and I'm happy to help with future submissions that fit our appetite.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
